events.NARROW_GATE.title: 窄门
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.description:
你来到一扇窄小的石门前。刚试着挤过去，门缝就夹住了你的背包，还拽出了几张牌。

门楣上的脸睁开眼睛。

“带得太多了！留下一张。”
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.options.REMOVE: 从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除这张牌。
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.options.REROLL: 支付[red]{Gold}[/red][gold]金币[/gold]。更换可移除的牌。仅限一次。
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.options.NO_ALT: 没有其他可供选择的牌。
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.REROLLED.description:
你把[gold]金币[/gold]塞进门缝，换了个角度再挤。

石门松开原先的牌，又夹住了另外几张。

“就这些。别再扭了！”
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.REMOVED.description:
你松开那张牌。石门咔哒一声，把它吞了进去。

“这就对了。”

门缝终于宽了些，你侧身挤了过去。
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.REST.description:
石门在你的背包上挤了半天，什么也没夹出来。

你索性坐下来歇了一会儿。等你站起身时，它已经睡着了，门缝也松开了一些。

events.NARROW_GATE.title: Narrow Gate
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.description:
You try to squeeze through a narrow stone door. The gap catches your pack and pulls out a few cards.

The face on the lintel opens its eyes.

“Too much luggage! Leave one.”
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.options.REROLL: Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold] to reroll the cards. Once only.
You have already rerolled the cards.
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.options.NO_ALT: There are no other eligible cards.
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.REROLLED.description:
You slip [gold]coins[/gold] into the gap and turn the other way.

The door releases the first cards and catches a different set.

“These will do. Stop squirming!”
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.REMOVED.description:
You let go of the card. The door swallows it with a click.

“Much better.”

The gap widens just enough for you to squeeze through.
events.NARROW_GATE.pages.REST.description:
The door squeezes your pack for a while, but fails to extract anything.

You sit down to rest. By the time you stand, it has fallen asleep and the gap has loosened.
